edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender and allowance spender in transferFrom
_value flows into balance and allowance updates in transferFrom
_from indexes balanceOf and allowance in transferFrom
_to is the recipient credited in transferFrom
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier
protectionFromBots address is the target of the call in checkBots
uniPair is passed as an argument to the bot-protection call
checkBots executes the low-level external call to protectionFromBots
transfer forwards msg.sender to transferFrom
_value is forwarded from transfer to transferFrom
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender
approve mutates the allowance mapping
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, a tx.origin-derived privilege
delegate authorization check is based on msg.sender
delegate forwards address and calldata into the delegatecall operation
parameter a is the delegatecall target
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata
distribute requires msg.sender == owner derived from tx.origin
distribute authorization check uses msg.sender
distribute performs an unchecked low-level call into protectionFromBots
distribute writes balances directly into balanceOf

loop index i iterates over _tos in distribute
list requires msg.sender == owner derived from tx.origin
list authorization check uses msg.sender
constructor sets owner = tx.origin, making tx.origin the privileged account
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline in list

list calls the routerForPancake state variable

list performs an unchecked low-level call into protectionFromBots
_tos recipients are credited in list
_amounts values are credited in list
_numList sets the contract balance and liquidity amount in list
totalSupply is read to compute owner allocation in list
totalSupply is multiplied then divided without SafeMath
list writes directly into the balanceOf mapping
constructor assigns owner from tx.origin
constructor assigns uniPair from pairForUniswap
constructor invokes pairForUniswap to derive the pair address
constructor sets infinite allowances in the allowance mapping

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter consumed solely by transferFrom for balance and allowance lookups
_to is a parameter consumed solely by transferFrom as the credit recipient
_value is a parameter consumed by transferFrom (and forwarded from transfer) for arithmetic
_tos is a parameter used by distribute to write balances
_amounts is a parameter used by list to write balances
_numList is a parameter used by list for balance and liquidity amounts
parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata inside delegate
isNotBot is the local return value of the protectionFromBots call in checkBots
loop index i exists only to iterate over _tos in distribute
